# Attest documentation map

Attest is a local-first CLI for authored agent-evaluation resources and immutable runs.
Use canonical pages and machine contracts; do not infer shapes from examples.

Start:

- docs/index.md — human and coding-agent navigation
- docs/quickstart.md — complete native agent to eval journey
- docs/cli/index.md — CLI workflow and machine-output contract

Concepts:

- docs/concepts/resource-model.md — project, resources, references, hashes, paths
- docs/concepts/eval-lifecycle.md — resolve, invoke, score, persist, render

Machine discovery:

- `attest help --output json` — command tree
- `attest help <namespace> <verb> --output json` — focused command contract
- `attest schema list --output json` — available schema ids
- `attest schema print <schema-id> --output json` — authoritative JSON Schema
- `attest errors --output json` — stable error registry and repairs

Reference:

- docs/reference/schemas.md — schema ids and generated artifacts
- docs/reference/errors.md — meaning, causes, retryability, exit codes, repairs
- docs/reference/exit-codes.md — process status contract
- docs/reference/file-layout.md — authored and runtime paths

CLI guides:

- docs/cli/agents.md
- docs/cli/tests-and-datasets.md
- docs/cli/metrics.md
- docs/cli/eval-runs.md

Integration guides:

- docs/integrations/native.md
- docs/integrations/curl-and-http.md
- docs/integrations/cli-processes.md
- docs/integrations/polling-and-streams.md
- docs/integrations/websockets.md

Protocols:

- docs/specs/agent-contract.md — attest.agent-invocation
- docs/specs/metric-contract.md — attest.metric-evaluation
- docs/specs/run-bundle.md — portable eval evidence
- docs/specs/trace-schema.md — attest.trace

Machine output:

- JSON is one `attest.cli-result` document.
- JSONL uses `attest.cli-event` per line; the final event is `result`.
- Mutation requests use `attest.command-request`.
- Prefer `error.code`, schema ids, and project hashes over prose parsing.
